Nutanix Platform Engineer

Location: Remote

Experience: 5+ Years

Joining: Immediate preferred

About the Role

V I Point Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Nutanix Platform Engineer to support a leading US-based managed hosting and cloud provider. The role involves building, configuring, securing, and supporting Nutanix-powered private cloud environments across management, staging, and production.

Key Responsibilities;

Deploy and configure Nutanix AOS, AHV, Foundation, and Prism Central.

Implement Flow Virtual Networking, VPCs, RBAC, tenant isolation, and microsegmentation.

Configure and validate firewall and network security across dedicated and multi-tenant environments.

Implement platform monitoring, alerting, and operational runbooks.

Perform performance testing and benchmarking using Nutanix X-Ray.

Support migrations from VMware and NetApp environments using Nutanix Move.

Coordinate with data center teams on rack, cabling, switching, and network bring-up.

Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and networking layers.

Document technical configurations and conduct knowledge transfer to engineering and operations teams.

Required Skills & Experience;

5+ years of experience in virtualization or infrastructure engineering.

Strong hands-on experience with Nutanix AOS, AHV, Prism Central, and Foundation.

Production experience with Flow Virtual Networking, VPC design, and microsegmentation.

Strong knowledge of VLANs, routing, ToR switching, and firewalls.

Working knowledge of NetApp ONTAP, including NFS/iSCSI datastores, volumes, and LUNs.

Experience working independently in fast-paced infrastructure deployment environments.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Willingness to overlap with US working hours when required.

Nice to Have;

Nutanix or Nutanix partner experience.

NCP/NCM certifications.

Managed hosting or service-provider experience.

VMware-to-Nutanix migration experience.

Experience with backup/DR integrations and automation using Ansible, Terraform, Prism APIs, or scripting.

ipv-penguin-data-centre-pvt-ltd-jr-full-.workDetails:
Penguin Data Centre is a travel business IT firm looking for a Jr. Full Stack Developer with 2 to 5 years of experience to join our team. We're seeking someone with strong experience in Angular v16/17, .NET 8, and MS SQL to help us with our research and development tasks.

Responsibilities include:

* Developing and maintaining web applications using Angular v16/17 and .NET 8

* Designing and managing MS SQL databases

* Working on research and development projects

* Staying up-to-date with cloud technologies like Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud

* Collaborating with team members to solve complex technical challenges

* Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code

To be successful in this role, you'll need:

* 3-5 years of experience as a full-stack developer

* Strong knowledge of Angular v16/17, .NET 8, and MS SQL

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure and AWS)

* Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly

* Good problem-solving and analytical skills

* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)

* Understanding of agile software development best practices

What We Offer:

* Opportunity to work on innovative projects in the travel industry

* Supportive and collaborative work environment

* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities

* Competitive salary and benefits package

* Flexible work arrangements

* Regular team-building activities and events

* Chance to grow your skills in cloud technologies

If you're passionate about full-stack development and want to be part of a dynamic team in the travel IT sector, we'd love to hear from you!

 If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, kindly share your updated resume with us at careers@penguininc.com
